description: This file defines the Response class and related classes for handling HTTP responses, including headers, cookies, and response content management in a web server context.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, managing status, headers, content, and cookies.

classes.name: MultipartContent
classes.description: Handles multipart response content, allowing parts to be appended and iterated over.

classes.name: MultipartPart
classes.description: Represents a single part within a multipart response, including headers and data.

classes.name: ResponseHeaders
classes.description: Manages HTTP headers for the response, supporting setting, appending, and retrieval.

classes.name: ResponseWriter
classes.description: Provides methods to write HTTP status, headers, and content to the output stream.

methods.name: Response.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a Response object with default headers and content.

methods.name: Response.set_cookie
methods.description: Sets a cookie to be sent with the response.

methods.name: Response.unset_cookie
methods.description: Removes a cookie from the response headers.

methods.name: Response.delete_cookie
methods.description: Deletes a cookie on the client by setting it to expire.

methods.name: Response.iter_content
methods.description: Iterates over the response content, handling strings, file-like objects, and callables.

methods.name: Response.write_status_headers
methods.description: Writes the HTTP status line and headers.

methods.name: Response.write_content
methods.description: Writes the response body content.

methods.name: Response.write
methods.description: Writes the entire response including headers and content.

methods.name: Response.set_error
methods.description: Sets the response to an error state with JSON body.

methods.name: MultipartContent.__call__
methods.description: Returns the multipart content as a string with boundaries.

methods.name: MultipartContent.append_part
methods.description: Adds a part to the multipart content.

methods.name: MultipartPart.__str__
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a multipart part with headers and data.

methods.name: ResponseHeaders.set
methods.description: Sets a header value, overwriting existing headers with the same name.

methods.name: ResponseHeaders.append
methods.description: Appends a header value without overwriting existing headers.

methods.name: ResponseHeaders.get
methods.description: Retrieves header values for a given header name.

methods.name: ResponseHeaders.__getitem__
methods.description: Gets list of values for a header.

methods.name: ResponseHeaders.__delitem__
methods.description: Deletes a header.

methods.name: ResponseHeaders.__contains__
methods.description: Checks if a header exists.

methods.name: ResponseHeaders.items
methods.description: Returns all headers as a list.

methods.name: ResponseHeaders.update
methods.description: Updates headers with an iterable of (name, value) pairs.

methods.name: ResponseWriter.write_status
methods.description: Writes the HTTP status line.

methods.name: ResponseWriter.write_header
methods.description: Writes a single header line.

methods.name: ResponseWriter.write_default_headers
methods.description: Writes default headers like Server and Date.

methods.name: ResponseWriter.end_headers
methods.description: Completes header writing and writes separator.

methods.name: ResponseWriter.write_content
methods.description: Writes response body data.

methods.name: ResponseWriter.write
methods.description: Writes data directly to the output stream.

methods.name: ResponseWriter.write_content_file
methods.description: Streams a file-like object to the output.

methods.name: ResponseWriter.encode
methods.description: Encodes unicode data to bytes using response encoding.

methods.name: ResponseWriter.flush
methods.description: Flushes the output stream.
